method: Viewed all concept angles, paired native model guides, both full source-photo boards and individual exact keeper/Branch photographs. Read selected product records and keeper build. Visual review does not establish physical dimensions from image pixels. No images or models modified.

actionable_findings.finding: Visible white lamp head reads as a solid glowing slab; exact ASIN B0C3BVYTXP photograph has an open rectangular central aperture with narrow parallel LED bars.
actionable_findings.source_guide_conflict: The current proxy has broad full-width mesh Upper and lower light panel across its rim, so guide reinforces this mismatch.
actionable_findings.correction: Keep modeled position, overall head envelope and orientation; represent the actual open rectangular aperture/LED bars from source photo. Do not enlarge or move lamp.
actionable_findings.limits: U-shaped floor base and rotary knob are substantially occluded in A, off-camera B, mostly cropped C; do not claim those parts are missing.

actionable_findings.finding: UPLIFT desktop is rendered much paler golden/blond than the official dark amber/brown highly contrasted longitudinal striped Pheasantwood source. Barkline front, thick top, nickel grommets and industrial gray C-frame are otherwise recognizable where visible.
actionable_findings.correction: Deepen warm brown/amber wood and strong striped grain, retaining every modeled footprint, thickness, frame geometry and camera.
actionable_findings.limits: B shows only a cropped desktop; no independent assertion of exact dimensions from images.

actionable_findings.finding: Visible upper baskets use airy thin radial strands compared with source chunky densely braided natural wicker.
actionable_findings.correction: Favor thicker densely braided wicker using source photo, preserving basket coordinates and all branch allocations.
actionable_findings.limits: Only two upper wicker baskets plus brown fleece hammock/condo are visible. Lower third wicker basket is occluded by desk/chair; not recorded as absent.

actionable_findings.severity: geometry mismatch also identified by root
actionable_findings.finding: The Blue Geometric print is above the secondary workstation rather than remaining near the owned UPLIFT anchor; Bold Blue appears on the desk-side white wall edge. Source designs themselves are recognizable.
actionable_findings.correction: Keep Blue Geometric above modeled UPLIFT anchor; Bold Blue stays on brick wall over sealed fireplace, therefore should be off-camera in this B view.

actionable_findings.finding: Generated C elaborates the sealed white fireplace with a conspicuous brick arched surround and larger projecting brick hearth/plinth than the model guide.
actionable_findings.correction: Preserve observed sealed panel and only the model guide's shallow sill. Do not invent a deep hearth or rebuilt arch.

passes.task_chairs: Two black Branch-like mesh task chairs with upholstered black seats, detailed lumbar/casters and no headrests; orientations consistent with model where visible. A shows both fully, B/C show one partly cropped.
passes.secondary_workstation: One white five-drawer ALEX on LEFT / x-negative end, black-brown top, right-end white legs; no second pedestal introduced.
passes.visitor_chair: Gray-turquoise corduroy upholstery and brown wooden arm/frame form recognizable as selected IKEA EKENASET. Partly cropped A/C, more complete B.
passes.clothes_chest: C shows one oak-effect three-flush-drawer STORKLINTA-style chest; A has cropped left edge. No added dresser count claim for hidden surfaces.
passes.rug: Ivory field with slate-blue stepped ink lines recognizable as selected Inkdrop. Low profile consistent with Flatwoven Standard Pad appearance; no pixel-derived size/thickness validation.
passes.cat_tree: Natural branched wood, two visible upper wicker bowls, brown fleece hammock, brown condo/base and arched condo entrance recognizable. Lower basket count remains occluded, not failed.
passes.artwork_content: Both blue designs recognizable, thin black framing; B placement must be corrected.

occluded_items_not_certified: closet GREJIG racks behind closed closet door
